title: Data levels
text:
Data levels

Data details supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

This field indicates the level of data (e.g. 
CRESTA
-level, sub-
CRESTA
, postal codes, province codes, governates, perfectures) in the import
 file. The 
DataLevel
 and 
Area tag type

 must match.

Go to the appropriate 
UNICEDE
/2 version and country name to view the list of valid Area Tags.
